standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the setting and supplies the compatibility with proper pushforward and with flat pullback that the proof relies on in both directions.

core_obligations: Record the trivial implications and reduce the third to the second: the first two implications are clear, and the third implies the second because the pushforward of the fundamental class of the proper birational source is the fundamental class of the target and a bivariant class commutes with proper pushforward (proof lines 6601-6605).

Reduce an arbitrary class to integral components: for a class on a locally finite type base, write it as a locally finite sum of integral closed subschemes of the given dimension and view it as the pushforward of a cycle along the proper morphism from the disjoint union of those components, so that by the properties of bivariant classes it suffices to prove the vanishing on the disjoint union (proof lines 6606-6612).

Conclude componentwise: the Chow group of the disjoint union is the product of the Chow groups of the pieces, the projections are given by flat pullback, and capping with the class commutes with flat pullback, so the vanishing reduces to the assumed vanishing for each integral piece (proof lines 6613-6619).
proof_roadmap: Trivial implications and the reduction of the third to the second (proof lines 6601-6605).
Reduce a general class to the disjoint union of its integral components (proof lines 6606-6612).
Use the product decomposition and flat pullback compatibility to conclude (proof lines 6613-6619).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives three equivalent criteria for a bivariant class to vanish: vanishing of the class itself, vanishing of its cap with the fundamental class of every integral locally finite type base, and the existence of a proper birational cover on which that cap vanishes (statement lines 6584-6599, tag 02UC). Two implications are immediate and the third is reduced to the second by the compatibility of a bivariant class with proper pushforward; the essential direction then reduces an arbitrary cycle class to a locally finite sum of integral components, passes to their disjoint union, and uses the product decomposition of the Chow group together with compatibility with flat pullback to conclude componentwise. That reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
